name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.21.0: opt-in bounded instruction inventory, lossless completed-index fold preview, and declared requirement/acceptance/check coverage with existing source-bound evidence. Static character counts do not prove host loading or provider cost. Fold plans never apply edits; mappings do not certify semantics or execution. Existing Tower helpers, memory, provenance, budgets and Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call, automatic migration, promotion or rollback.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
